attrs.description: Every Restate service, served from Lambda and the box.

Bundle the Lambda handler: dist/lambda.zip with app/lambda.mjs (one ESM file, handler `app/lambda.handler`) and app/box.mjs (the pool chain on the Postgres box, `node app/box.mjs`), the niche templates beside it (the niches resolve `../templates` from their module), the migrations (the db resolves `../drizzle`, so the worker can migrate a new client's database: the SQL files and the journal, not the snapshots), the sender roster when the repo has one, and playwright-core for the Browserbase render tier
`pnpm templates:export <file> [--check]`: write the gallery snapshot for the lander, or (with --check) exit 1 when the file on disk differs
The box worker's two slots
The pool chain served from the Postgres box
Every component, from every package: the source for the catalog, installs and gating
Wren's console records (`makeConsolePortal`'s `records`): the one list the worker, the portal preview (`apps/portal/scripts/preview.ts`) and the page stories' types (`./record-types.ts`) serve
The public template gallery: the code's client templates as JSON for the lander to build pages from
What a journey's node `research` runs (packages/pipeline/src/research.ts), from the research code that exists
The same services as `main.ts`, served to Restate Cloud from AWS Lambda
`LineFeed/all`: Wren's content lines fed to the executor
Restate endpoint on Node: serves every channel's services on :9080
The Marketing app's records, from each channel that keeps the numbers
`PainFeed/all`: the pain points line
Parts we need and haven't built: designs, not catalog
The copy records' `edits` (`@wren/core/edits`): William's words for a text or a DM slot, edited in place on the record with History, Undo and Ask Claude

Every record type the worker serves, built without a database, a bucket or the lander: Wren's console (`consoleRecords` and the console's own), each client component's, People's and a client's Marketing
The Friday review (direction doc, "How to juggle"): every parked idea, what unparks it, and a live check where prod keeps the number
Every Restate service the worker serves, built once from settings
Client accounts: setups watched and run, the Accounts console, mail, social and connector access with their callbacks, the social inbox, the mail reader and marketing bounces
The portal's product apps: voice, templates, notes, sites, payments, documents, journeys and the pipeline console
The books' day and its console
Our booking calendar and each client's, through the phone Worker's /calendar door
Clients: health and flags, delivery and billing with their portals, domains, Ask, tokens and call briefs
The content channels per invocation and a client's, Meta ads' dependencies, and where Reddit calls go: what `Content`, `Ads` and the research chain are wired with
Content: the Blog box and Pieces, the channels and Meta ads, the content loop (desk, scheduler, metrics, planner), the social inbox and desk, auto-reply, comment keywords and the site chat
The shared objects every domain file wires its services from (`buildDeps`), the module-level helpers more than one domain uses, and the `Deps` type they all take

Cold email: the send and inbox schedulers, disposition, call bookings, marketing mail and the newsletter, compose and the queue, placement, Postmaster, opens and clicks, the Friday report, and the Email console
The executor: every workspace's journeys stepped, and each Schedule node's clock
People: a client's People console, segments, the people map, the touch and sourced feeds, and broadcasts
The platform's own loops: token renewal, the vault's keys, audit seals, Decide, webhooks, dead letters and the loop watch, and the console portal every page calls
Cold outreach on Reddit and LinkedIn over the Mac's desk worker: sender, watch, desk, comment proofs and Reddit reads
Reactivation: a client's portal, the loop, and the CLI's `crm run` door
The research chain: enrichment, profile research, discovery and resolution over the pool, the pool-feeder that walks them per niche, and the page archive that moves old page HTML off the box
Search: Search Console daily, the answer engines and edit proposals weekly
Cold SMS: the sender, events, reviews, desk, watch, site forms and console
The Monitor: new mail onto the `watch` workflow, Learn's pictures, and the Watch and Learn consoles
Every setup: core's Google and Meta, the phone's, email's, Stripe's for pay links, client mail access, client social accounts
`SourcedFeed/all`: a person added to a list that a live sourced source of the shape takes people from is told to the executor as a `trigger.source` fire, and the shape opens a journey
Wake on row: a row a loop must act on fires `pg_notify('wren_wake', '<Service>/<unit>')` at commit (migration 0235)
Every workflow: each package's own, and here the ones that cross packages
